facilities.name: BridgeWell Kids
facilities.description: A place where children learn, play and grow together, with a school, a playground and a learning garden.

facilities.name: BridgeWell Senior
facilities.description: A place for older adults to connect, stay active and enjoy healthy living, with a community hall, an exercise area and a shaded garden.

facilities.name: BridgeWell Recovery
facilities.description: Supports rehabilitation and a safe return to daily life at home, with an accessible home model and caregiver support.

facilities.name: BridgeWell X Lab
facilities.description: A research and development studio for AI, XR and robotics, using 3D printing, sensors and drones.
